title: Randomized Trial of Icatibant for Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitor-Induced Upper Airway Angioedema
authors: Sinert R, Levy P, Bernstein JA, Body R, Sivilotti MLA, Moellman J, et al.; CAMEO study group
journal: Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology: In Practice
population: Adults taking ACE inhibitors presenting within 12 hours of at least moderately severe upper-airway angio-oedema at 31 centres in 4 countries
funder: The registry entry names Shire as lead sponsor, with PPD Development as collaborator; four authors are Shire employees in clinical development and biostatistics. The funding statement of the article was not read.
result: Icatibant 30 mg (n=61) against placebo (n=60), given a median 7.8 hours after symptom onset. Median time to meeting discharge criteria 4.0 hours in each group (P=0.63); median time to onset of symptom relief 2.0 against 1.6 hours (P=0.57); no difference in any secondary end point or subgroup.
